title: Fluid screen transitions
summary: Primary screens now slide and morph into one another as one continuous transition instead of snapping at the handoff.
changes: Night, Changes, Breaks and Chat now hand off as one continuous slide, including the final moment when the new screen becomes active.
The outgoing screen subtly scales and fades while the incoming screen settles into place, producing a restrained morph effect without obscuring clinical content.
Bottom-tab taps and long bottom-bar drags now use the same transition language as page swipes, with the selected tab indicator moving in sync.
Reduced-motion users keep immediate navigation. Roster calculations, Supabase data, authentication and staffing rules are unchanged.
